name: FluxGym
summary: Dead-simple local web UI squeezing clean FLUX.1 Dev LoRA training comfortably into 12GB consumer GPUs via Kohya scripts.
ranking_rationale: Makes training custom local Flux LoRAs approachable with automatic Florence-2 captioning, weighed against single-purpose Flux LoRA trainer (use SwarmUI/ComfyUI for actual generation).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Makes training custom local Flux LoRAs approachable with automatic Florence-2 captioning
Runs in 12GB–16GB consumer VRAM via memory quantization
cons: Single-purpose Flux LoRA trainer (use SwarmUI/ComfyUI for actual generation)
Needs patience over multi-hour training loops on 12GB cards
